nucleophiles add to the carbon pi-bonds of diene and aree-metal complexes.
the metal-carbon pi bond in metal-diene and metal-arene complexes is nucleophilic.

the attachment of a metal carbonyl unit to an olefin or an arene induces a polarizability in the pi bond systems that allows for addition of anions and that the addition can be directed by substituents on the olefin or the arene to provide a new route for synthesis of organic products.

the synthesis of new organic compounds from simple precursors by using transition metal complexes.
the development and application of new synthetic methods for organic molecules.
the development of new reactions which are useful for the synthesis of organic products.

the addition reactions described herein have been shown to be useful in the synthesis of complex natural products and that they have been demonstrated to be general and synthetically useful reactions.

a new class of organometallic reagents, the metal diene and metal arene complexes, has been developed and applied to a variety of organic transformations.
